NONE: A2 any of the five separate parts at the end of the foot
腳趾
› the part of a sock, shoe, or other foot covering that goes over the toes
（襪、鞋等的）足尖部
C2 to do what you are ordered or expected to do
服從；聽從

example: your big toe (= your largest toe)
你的大腳趾
your little toe (= your smallest toe)
你的小腳趾
I stubbed (= hit) my toe on the edge of the bed.
我的腳趾撞到了床沿。
Ministers who wouldn't toe the party line were swiftly got rid of.
不願遵從該政黨方針的部長們被立刻免職。

NONE: › a hard covering to protect the toes in a shoe or boot
鞋頭，外包頭

example: metal toe caps
金屬的鞋外包頭

NONE: › a kick of a football, especially a hard kick, that is made using the end of your toe
（足球運動中，尤指以腳趾觸球方式）大力踢球
› to kick a football with the end of your toe
以腳趾觸球方式踢足球

example: Most children start out doing toe pokes, so we train them to use the side of their foot.
大部分孩子開始的時候都用腳趾部位大力踢球，所以我們訓練他們使用腳側。
He managed to stick out a leg and toe-poke Ramsey's cross into the net.
他成功出腳，用腳趾部位把拉姆齊橫穿而來的球送入網窩。

NONE: › making you feel extremely embarrassed and ashamed for someone else
令人極其尷尬的；使人十分害臊的

example: I saw the worst comedy act I've ever seen last night - it was absolutely toe-curling!
昨晚我看到我所見過最糟糕的喜劇表演——真替他感到害臊！

NONE: › directly opposing or competing with each other
正對面；直接競爭

example: We don’t have to go toe-to-toe with our competitors in every market.
我們不需要在每一個市場與我們的競爭者正面直接競爭。

NONE: › having toes as described
…趾的；有…趾的

example: open-toed sandals
露腳趾的涼鞋
the two-toed sloth
兩趾樹懶

NONE: › abbreviation for Test of English as a Foreign Language: a test of English for speakers of other languages
託福考試（Test of English as a Foreign Language 的縮寫）

C: › a small hole or surface on a rock that is just big enough for a climber to put the end of his or her foot in or on
（攀岩時僅可放下足尖的）小立足點，小支撐點
› a strong first position from which further progress can be made

example: I searched desperately for a toehold in the rock face.
我努力在岩石表面尋找立足點。
Insurance is a very difficult market to get a toehold in.
在保險市場中立足很難。

NONE: B2 the hard, slightly curved part that covers and protects the end of a toe
腳趾甲

example: She was cutting/painting her toenails.
她在剪／塗趾甲。

NONE: › an extremely unpleasant person
極其令人討厭的人；混蛋
